$comment: Shared quick-search contract (Issue #555, ListParams.search): a row matches when ANY text column contains the trimmed term, case-insensitively, with % _ \ matched literally; a missing, empty or whitespace-only term is no search; NULL never matches; the search is ANDed with `filters`. `textFields` are the text columns (SQL: ColumnMap::text_column; InMemory: InMemorySeed.searchFields; grid client: columns whose filterType is text). `price` (a number) and `day` (a date string) are deliberately NOT text columns, so a term found only there matches nothing. Asserted by banto-storage (SQLite + PostgreSQL, list_query.rs), the InMemory DataProvider (packages/admin-core/tests/listOrderParity.test.ts) and the grid's client search (packages/grid-svelte/tests/search.test.ts). `expectedIds` are in id order. Case folding is ASCII-only in SQLite, so no case relies on folding a non-ASCII letter.

cases.name: an empty term is no search
a whitespace-only term is no search
found only in the second text column
a number column is not searched
a date column is not searched
a blank term keeps the filters alone
